::: {#exm-pairs-accept}
#### Tracing three strings

These are the runs (@def-run) of the DFA $A$ of @exm-pairs-dfa on three strings of @exr-pairs:

| string | run | last state | verdict |
|:---|:---|:---:|:---|
| $\mathtt{abab}$ | $q_0, q_1, q_0, q_1, q_0$ | $q_0$ | accepts |
| $\mathtt{aab}$ | $q_0, q_1, q_2, q_2$ | $q_2$ | rejects |
| $\mathtt{ba}$ | $q_0, q_0, q_1$ | $q_1$ | rejects |

So $A$ accepts (@def-accept) $\mathtt{abab}$, which passes the check of @exr-pairs,
and rejects $\mathtt{aab}$ and $\mathtt{ba}$, which fail it.
Its run on $\lambda$ is $q_0$ alone, so it accepts $\lambda$.

:::
